A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Iris research work and contain complete, readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and supplementary Sections 6–10. All content can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original Iris evaluations on ScreenSpot, GroundUI-1K, Mind2Web, and AITW in Tables 1–4, alongside component and efficiency analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results and ablation analyses, with three numerical corrections in the SRDL ablation discussion.

M1.justification: Information-Sensitive Cropping, Self-Refining Dual Learning, both hard-case mining procedures, and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. The supplementary implementation descriptions also remain identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same GUI and LLaVA training data, self-annotated samples, and four evaluation benchmarks: ScreenSpot, GroundUI-1K, Mind2Web, and AITW. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in each of Tables 1–4. The efficiency comparisons and SRDL ablation variants also retain the same comparison methods.

E3.justification: Training configurations, evaluation subsets, metrics, and testing procedures are unchanged in Section 4 and supplementary Sections 8–10. The corrected ablation numbers are not accompanied by a reported protocol change.

E4.justification: The same analyses test ISC token efficiency across visual complexity and the contributions of SRDL and its mining strategies. Figures 4–5 and the tested configurations are unchanged; only three numbers in the accompanying prose are corrected.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Section 4.4 changes the stated accuracies for w/o V from 68.3% to 71.4%, w/o F from 67.9% to 72.1%, and full SRDL from 71.0% to 74.6%. These corrections match Figure 5, which already displays the latter values in v1. The figures and benchmark tables themselves are unchanged.

T1.justification: The task definitions, Equations 1–6, and supplementary Section 7's computational-complexity analysis are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning ISC efficiency, SRDL accuracy, annotation efficiency, and downstream agent performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of adaptive token allocation and complementary visual and functional mining remain unchanged. The numerical corrections introduce no new mechanism explanation, applicability boundary, or limitation.

D1.justification: The supplementary preprocessing pipeline and training details are identical, including AdamW, cosine scheduling, the 3e-5 initial learning rate, and batch size 64. No implementation or resource-access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2, the citations and reference list, and the positioning relative to earlier GUI agents and high-resolution MLLMs are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Apart from the three numerical substitutions in Section 4.4, the prose, terminology, headings, and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5, Tables 1–4, algorithm displays, captions, and their placement are unchanged. The numerical prose corrections and updated arXiv stamp introduce no figure, table, or layout redesign.

improvement.justification: v2 resolves three contradictions between Section 4.4's prose and the unchanged Figure 5, making the SRDL ablation results internally consistent. This improves reporting accuracy and readability, while the methods, experimental evidence, and supplementary material remain unchanged.
